<!DOCTYPE html>
<!--
================================================================================
  REPORT: Purchasing Dashboard (v1.2 — GridStack re-platform)
  PATH:   Dashboards/Purchasing_Dashboard_v1.2.htm
  --------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  v1.2 — Full re-platform of Dashboards/Purchasing_Dashboard.htm (the
  stateless D3 original, which stays untouched) onto the GridStack
  "Workspace" architecture of Dashboards/Sales_Dashboard_v1.2.htm:

    - GridStack 12-col drag/resize grid, per-user layouts via FBLib.Settings
      (userproperties-backed; keys cdx.bi.purchdash.user.v1 / master.v1),
      admin publish + user-editing lock, KPI header badge strip, widget
      picker, generic drilldown modal (search / sort / CSV / PO line-item
      expansion), fb-styles chrome + fb-lib shared helpers.
    - Every legacy tile ported (SQL near-verbatim from the old file), plus
      three NEW tiles: receipt-calendar (open PO value by week due),
      leadtime-trend (monthly avg lead time from receiptitem.dateReceived),
      pending-approval (statusId 15 queue).
    - Filter strip: date range presets + Vendor / Category / ABC Code /
      Location. Spend & receipt-history tiles honor the date strip
      (postpo.DateCreated, po-status uses po.dateIssued); open-PO snapshot
      tiles (expected receipts, overdue, pending approval, receipt calendar)
      always show the current open book and IGNORE it.

  REQUIRES: the current fb-styles Style AND fb-lib Script must be saved on
  the Fishbowl server FIRST (re-save both before saving this report).

  BACKLOG (not in this version):
    - getAutoPo suggested-reorders tile
    - partial-receipt fill-rate by vendor
    - open PO value by category donut
================================================================================
-->
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
  <title>Purchasing Dashboard v1.2</title>

  <script src="https://cdn.tailwindcss.com"></script>
  <link  rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/gridstack@10.3.1/dist/gridstack.min.css">
  <script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/gridstack@10.3.1/dist/gridstack-all.js"></script>
  <script src="https://d3js.org/d3.v7.min.js"></script>
  <!-- Moment.js — loads BEFORE fb-lib so its Common.formatDate sees moment. -->
  <script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/moment.js/2.29.4/moment.min.js"></script>

  <!-- Shared Fishbowl BI lib, inlined by Fishbowl from the saved "fb-lib"
       script (source: scripts/fb-lib.js). Must sit BEFORE the shared style
       include so window.FBLib exists by the time inline code runs. -->
  <script>
    {% Script fb-lib %}
  </script>

  <!-- Shared chrome (source: scripts/fb-styles.css). Owns .fb-drawer,
       toasts, .ds-lock-badge and debug-drawer chrome. -->
  <style>
    {% Style fb-styles %}
  </style>

  <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@300;400;500;600;700;800;900&family=Space+Mono:wght@400;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">

  <style>
    /* ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
       Design tokens come from fb-styles — the SINGLE source of truth
       for the palette (blues, neutrals, --link, --menu-bg, accent
       pairs, radii, shadows). Do NOT redeclare shared tokens here:
       a local copy silently overrides fb-styles and the report stops
       following theme updates. Only report-specific tokens live below.
       REQUIRES the current fb-styles to be saved on the server —
       re-save the fb-styles Style before re-saving this report.
       ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
    :root {
      /* Legacy accent names this report references — fb-styles ships
         --acc-purple/--acc-sage instead; values track the brand pairs. */
      --acc-magenta:#845EEB; --acc-magenta-bg:#D9CEF7; --acc-magenta-con:#3D2380;
      --acc-teal:#4CA585; --acc-teal-bg:#C3D9CE; --acc-teal-con:#1B7A46;
      /* Fonts (fb-styles sets font-family on body, not as tokens). */
      --font:'Inter',-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Segoe UI',Roboto,sans-serif;
      --mono:'Space Mono',ui-monospace,'Consolas',monospace;
      /* Back-compat aliases onto fb-styles tokens (.order-link etc.). */
      --primary:var(--fb-blue); --primary-dark:var(--fb-blue-accent);
    }
    *, *::before, *::after { box-sizing: border-box; }
    html, body { height: 100%; margin: 0; padding: 0; overflow: hidden; font-family: var(--font); background: var(--bg-2); color: var(--c-primary); }
    .mono { font-family: var(--mono); }

    /* ── Scrollbar ─────────────────────────────────────── */
    ::-webkit-scrollbar { width: 8px; height: 8px; }
    ::-webkit-scrollbar-track { background: transparent; }
    ::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb { background: var(--bg-4); border-radius: 4px; }
    ::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover { background: var(--fb-neutral); }

    /* ── App shell — flex column; shrinks by the fb-lib debug-drawer
       height (observer in applyDebugDrawer writes --debug-drawer-h) ── */
    /* Divide the viewport height by --ps-zoom (set by psApplyZoom): body `zoom`
       shrinks the whole subtree WITHOUT rescaling vh, so a plain 100vh shell
       renders short at zoom<1 — dividing makes layout-height x zoom land back on
       the real viewport. --ps-zoom defaults to 1, so this is a no-op at 100%. */
    .app-col { display: flex; flex-direction: column; height: calc((100vh - var(--debug-drawer-h, 0px)) / var(--ps-zoom, 1)); transition: height .12s ease; }
    #main-content { flex: 1; min-height: 0; overflow-y: auto; padding: 16px 22px; }
    .grid-stack { background: transparent; }
    .grid-stack-item-content { border-radius: var(--r-card); overflow: hidden; }
    .grid-stack-placeholder > .placeholder-content { background: rgba(45,156,219,.08); border: 2px dashed var(--fb-blue); border-radius: var(--r-card); }

    /* .topbar family, .ps-btn family (incl. .sm.ok/.sm.ro/.on) and the
       .spill status pills all ship from fb-styles (§22/23/27) — no local
       copies. Re-save the fb-styles Style BEFORE re-saving this report. */

    /* ── KPI badge strip (inline in topbar row 1, next to the title) ── */
    .kpi-strip { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; flex: 1; min-width: 0; overflow-x: auto; margin: 0 14px; }
    .kpi-badge { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 5px 10px; background: var(--bg-1);
      border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: var(--r-card); position: relative; flex-shrink: 0; transition: .12s; }
    .kpi-badge:hover { border-color: var(--border-strong); box-shadow: var(--sh1); }
    .kpi-badge .kpi-badge-icon { width: 14px; height: 14px; flex-shrink: 0; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; }
    .kpi-badge .kpi-badge-icon svg { width: 100%; height: 100%; }
    .kpi-badge .kpi-badge-text { display: flex; flex-direction: column; line-height: 1; }
    .kpi-badge-val { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 800; line-height: 1.1; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
    .kpi-badge-lbl { font-size: 9px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--c-secondary); text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .05em; margin-top: 2px; }
    .badge-remove { display: none; position: absolute; top: 2px; right: 4px; background: none; border: none; color: var(--fb-negative); font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1; cursor: pointer; padding: 0; opacity: .6; }
    .badge-remove:hover { opacity: 1; }
    body:not(.dashboard-locked) .badge-remove { display: block; }
    .kpi-badge.drag-over { border-color: var(--fb-blue) !important; background: #DEEAF4 !important; }
    .kpi-badge[draggable=true] { cursor: grab; }
    .badge-add-btn { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 26px; height: 34px; border: 1px dashed var(--border-strong); border-radius: var(--r-card); background: none; color: var(--c-tertiary); cursor: pointer; transition: all .15s; flex-shrink: 0; }
    .badge-add-btn:hover { border-color: var(--fb-blue); color: var(--fb-blue); }
    .dashboard-locked .badge-add-btn { display: none; }

    /* .filterbar/.fchip + the .fdrop dropdown family ship from fb-styles
       (§25/26). This dashboard's dots use the ring style — its dropdown
       builders emit class "fdrop-dot hollow" (fills blue when .sel). */

    /* ── Settings-drawer toggle rows (fb-drawer content helper) ── */
    .ds-toggle-row { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 10px; padding: 6px 10px; border-radius: var(--r-card); cursor: pointer; font-size: 12px; }
    .ds-toggle-row:hover { background: var(--bg-1); }
    .ds-toggle-row input { accent-color: var(--fb-blue); margin-top: 2px; }
    .ds-toggle-title { font-weight: 600; color: var(--c-primary); }
    .ds-toggle-help { font-size: 11px; color: var(--c-secondary); margin-top: 1px; }

    /* ── Widget chrome (DS card look; class names unchanged) ── */
    .widget-wrapper { width: 100%; height: 100%; display: flex; flex-direction: column; background: #fff;
      border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: var(--r-card); overflow: hidden; box-shadow: var(--sh1); transition: box-shadow .2s; }
    .widget-wrapper:hover { box-shadow: var(--sh2); }
    .widget-header { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 10px 14px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); flex-shrink: 0; background: #fff; cursor: grab; user-select: none; }
    .widget-header:active { cursor: grabbing; }
    .widget-drag-handle { color: var(--bg-4); display: flex; align-items: center; flex-shrink: 0; transition: color .15s; }
    .widget-header:hover .widget-drag-handle { color: var(--c-tertiary); }
    .widget-icon { width: 16px; height: 16px; color: var(--fb-blue); flex-shrink: 0; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; }
    .widget-icon svg { width: 100%; height: 100%; }
    .widget-title { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--c-primary); flex: 1; white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; }

    /* CRITICAL FIX: padding:0 so clientHeight = exact usable area for D3 */
    .widget-body { flex: 1; overflow: hidden; padding: 0; position: relative; min-height: 0; }

    .widget-remove { width: 24px; height: 24px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; color: var(--c-tertiary); border-radius: 4px; border: none; background: none; cursor: pointer; transition: all .15s; flex-shrink: 0; }
    .widget-remove:hover { color: var(--fb-negative); background: #F0D7DD; }
    /* Export button reuses the .widget-remove 24px icon-button base but keeps
       its own (non-red) hover; it's read-only so it stays visible when locked. */
    .widget-export { color: var(--c-tertiary); }
    .widget-export:hover:not(:disabled) { color: var(--fb-blue); background: var(--bg-1); }
    .widget-export:disabled { opacity: .35; cursor: default; }

    .chart-toggle-btn { width: 24px; height: 22px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 4px; cursor: pointer; background: transparent; color: var(--c-tertiary); transition: all .15s; }
    .chart-toggle-btn.active { background: #DEEAF4; border-color: #CBE5FB; color: var(--fb-blue); }
    .chart-toggle-btn:hover:not(.active) { color: var(--c-secondary); }

    .info-icon-btn { width: 22px; height: 22px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border: none; border-radius: 4px; background: transparent; color: var(--c-tertiary); cursor: help; flex-shrink: 0; transition: color .15s, background .15s; padding: 0; }
    .info-icon-btn:hover { color: var(--fb-blue); background: var(--bg-1); }
    .info-icon-btn svg { width: 14px; height: 14px; }

    /* ── D3 ────────────────────────────────────────────── */
    .axis line, .axis path { stroke: var(--bg-3); shape-rendering: crispEdges; }
    .axis text { fill: var(--c-secondary); font-size: 10px; font-family: inherit; }
    .grid-line { stroke: var(--bg-2); stroke-width: 1; }

    /* ── Sortable table (in-widget; light DS treatment) ──── */
    .data-table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; }
    .data-table th { background: var(--bg-1); padding: 6px 10px; text-align: left; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--c-secondary); text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .04em; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); position: sticky; top: 0; cursor: pointer; white-space: nowrap; user-select: none; z-index: 1; }
    .data-table th:hover { background: var(--bg-2); }
    .data-table td { padding: 5px 10px; font-size: 11px; color: var(--c-primary); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--bg-2); white-space: nowrap; }
    .data-table tbody tr:hover td { background: var(--bg-1); }

    /* ── KPI widget (headerless gridstack tile hosting the shared icon-chip
       anatomy from fb-styles §28: .kpi-chip / .kpi-text / .kpi-lbl /
       .kpi-val / .kpi-delta. Controls float top-right on hover; the whole
       tile is the drag handle. Marker class is .kpi-widget — NOT the shared
       .kpi-tile card, whose padding/flex would fight .widget-wrapper.) ── */
    .widget-wrapper.kpi-widget { position: relative; }
    body:not(.dashboard-locked) .kpi-widget { cursor: grab; }
    body:not(.dashboard-locked) .kpi-widget:active { cursor: grabbing; }
    .kpi-controls { position: absolute; top: 5px; right: 6px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 1px; z-index: 5;
      opacity: 0; transition: opacity .15s; background: rgba(255,255,255,.9); border-radius: 4px; padding: 1px; }
    .kpi-widget:hover .kpi-controls { opacity: 1; }
    .kpi-controls .widget-drag-handle { width: 20px; height: 20px; align-items: center; justify-content: center; display: flex; }
    .kpi-root { height: 100%; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 10px 16px; position: relative; }
    .kpi-root .kpi-val { font-size: clamp(20px, 2.4vw, 28px); }

    /* ── Narrow tile (w=1) ── */
    .grid-stack-item.w-narrow .kpi-root { padding: 8px 10px; gap: 8px; }
    .grid-stack-item.w-narrow .kpi-root .kpi-val { font-size: clamp(15px, 3.6vw, 22px); }
    .grid-stack-item.w-narrow .kpi-chip { width: 30px; height: 30px; border-radius: 7px; }
    .grid-stack-item.w-narrow .kpi-chip svg { width: 15px; height: 15px; }

    /* ── Skeleton loader (@keyframes spin ships from fb-styles §19) ── */
    .tile-skel { height: 100%; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; }
    .tile-skel-spin { width: 24px; height: 24px; border: 3px solid var(--bg-3); border-top-color: var(--fb-blue); border-radius: 50%; animation: spin .8s linear infinite; }
    .tile-skel-lbl { font-size: 11px; color: var(--c-tertiary); }

    /* ── Locked state ──────────────────────────────────── */
    .dashboard-locked .widget-remove:not(.widget-export) { visibility: hidden; pointer-events: none; }
    .dashboard-locked .widget-drag-handle { visibility: hidden; }
    .dashboard-locked .widget-header { cursor: default !important; }
    .dashboard-locked .widget-header:active { cursor: default !important; }
    .dashboard-locked .gs-resizable-handle { display: none !important; }

    /* ── Compact buttons: standardise EVERY .ps-btn on the 28px "sm" size
       (matches Production_Scheduling_v1.2) so no control towers over the rest.
       fb-styles ships .ps-btn at 36px; override here. Glyphs stay 16px so icon
       buttons read clearly in the 28px box. ── */
    .ps-btn { height: 28px; padding: 0 10px; font-size: 12px; }
    .ps-btn svg, .ps-btn.sm svg { width: 16px; height: 16px; }
    .ps-btn.icon { width: 28px; padding: 0; }

    /* ── Top-bar app-level ZOOM control (- / % / +) — drives document.body.style.zoom
       so the whole dashboard scales to fit sub-1920 screens (JxBrowser exposes no
       user zoom). See psZoomInit / psApplyZoom. ── */
    .ps-zoom { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 2px; }
    .ps-zoom-lbl { min-width: 46px; height: 28px; padding: 0 8px; border: 1px solid var(--border-strong);
      border-radius: var(--r-btn); background: #fff; color: var(--c-secondary); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700;
      font-family: inherit; cursor: pointer; text-align: center; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
    .ps-zoom-lbl:hover { background: var(--bg-1); border-color: var(--fb-neutral); color: var(--fb-blue); }

    /* ── Tooltip ───────────────────────────────────────── */
    #ttip { position: fixed; background: rgba(16,16,16,.95); color: white; padding: 10px 14px; border-radius: 6px; font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.5; pointer-events: none; opacity: 0; transition: opacity .15s; z-index: 10000; max-width: 260px; box-shadow: var(--sh3); }

    /* ── Modals (DS: --r-modal, blur overlay) ──────────── */
    /* top/left:0 + width/height ÷ --ps-zoom (not inset:0) so the overlay still
       covers the whole screen under body zoom — a fixed inset:0 box renders
       short/narrow at zoom<1, same as the app shell above. */
    .modal-overlay { position: fixed; top: 0; left: 0; width: calc(100vw / var(--ps-zoom, 1)); height: calc(100vh / var(--ps-zoom, 1)); background: rgba(0,0,0,.5); backdrop-filter: blur(4px); z-index: 9000; display: none; align-items: center; justify-content: center; }
    .modal-overlay.show { display: flex; }
    .modal-box { background: #fff; border-radius: var(--r-modal); box-shadow: var(--sh3); display: flex; flex-direction: column; overflow: hidden; }
    /* fb-styles' .modal-head is white + slim since 2026-07, but this
       dashboard's modals use h2 titles + a .sub line and its own
       .show/.modal-box open mechanics, so the local rules stay. .close-x
       (28px) ships from fb-styles §33. */
    .modal-head { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px;
      padding: 9px 16px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); flex-shrink: 0;
      background: #fff; color: var(--c-primary); border-radius: 0; }
    .modal-head h2 { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 800; color: var(--c-primary); margin: 0; line-height: 1.2; }
    .modal-head .sub { font-size: 11px; color: var(--c-secondary); margin: 1px 0 0; }
    .tab-btn { padding: 6px 14px; font-size: 12.5px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--c-secondary); border: 1px solid var(--border-strong); background: #fff; cursor: pointer; border-radius: var(--r-pill); transition: all .15s; font-family: inherit; }
    .tab-btn:hover { background: var(--bg-1); }
    .tab-btn.active { background: var(--fb-blue); border-color: var(--fb-blue-accent); color: white; }
    /* Uniform picker cards: #pickerGrid sizes each row track to its tallest card
       (grid-auto-rows:max-content) and stretches the others to match, so the
       bottom-pinned Add button lines up across a row regardless of description. */
    .widget-card { background: #fff; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: var(--r-card); padding: 14px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; min-height: 186px; transition: border-color .15s, box-shadow .15s; }
    .widget-card:hover { border-color: var(--fb-blue); box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(45,156,219,.12); }
    /* Bottom-align the Add button so cards with/without the chart-type select match. */
    .widget-card .picker-add-btn { margin-top: auto; }
    .picker-added-chip { font-size: 9px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--fb-success); background: var(--acc-sage); border: 1px solid #A9CDBA; padding: 2px 7px; border-radius: 20px; white-space: nowrap; }

    /* ── Drilldown table — .tbl-wrap card ships from fb-styles (§30);
       the compact sortable .dd-table skin below is this dashboard's. ── */
    #drilldownModal .dd-body { flex: 1; overflow-y: auto; padding: 16px 20px; }
    .dd-table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; font-size: 12px; }
    .dd-table th { background: var(--menu-bg); color: #fff; padding: 7px 12px; text-align: left; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .04em; position: sticky; top: 0; z-index: 2; cursor: pointer; white-space: nowrap; user-select: none; }
    .dd-table th:hover { background: #164A5F; }
    .dd-table td { padding: 6px 12px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--bg-2); color: var(--c-primary); }
    .dd-table tbody tr:hover td { background: var(--bg-1); cursor: pointer; }

    /* ── Misc overrides ────────────────────────────────── */
    .bg-indigo-600 { background-color: var(--primary) !important; }
    .text-indigo-600 { color: var(--primary) !important; }
    .hover\:text-indigo-600:hover { color: var(--primary) !important; }
    /* .order-link ships from fb-styles (§31). */
  </style>
</head>
<body>

<!-- ═══ APP SHELL (flex column — topbar / drawers / filterbar / grid) ═════ -->
<div class="app-col">

<!-- ═══ TOPBAR ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ -->
<div class="topbar">
  <div class="topbar-row1">
    <div class="title-wrap">
      <span class="crumb">Purchasing · Analytics</span>
      <h1>Purchasing Dashboard</h1>
      <span class="subline" id="dateRangeDisplay">Loading…</span>
    </div>
    <!-- KPI header badges — inline with the title; drag to reorder, hover to remove, + to add -->
    <div id="kpiBadges" class="kpi-strip" style="display:none;"></div>
    <div class="top-actions">
      <!-- App-level zoom (- / % / +) — scales the whole dashboard to fit sub-1920 screens (JxBrowser has no user zoom). -->
      <div class="ps-zoom" title="Zoom the whole dashboard to fit your screen. Click the % to auto-fit.">
        <button class="ps-btn icon" type="button" onclick="psZoomStep(-1)" title="Zoom out"><svg fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path stroke-linecap="round" d="M5 12h14"/></svg></button>
        <button type="button" class="ps-zoom-lbl" id="psZoomLabel" onclick="psZoomAuto()" title="Click to auto-fit to this screen">100%</button>
        <button class="ps-btn icon" type="button" onclick="psZoomStep(1)" title="Zoom in"><svg fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path stroke-linecap="round" d="M12 5v14M5 12h14"/></svg></button>
      </div>
      <button class="ps-btn icon" type="button" onclick="refreshDashboard()" title="Refresh data">
        <svg fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" d="M4 4v6h6M20 20v-6h-6M20 8a8 8 0 00-14.9-2M4 16a8 8 0 0014.9 2"/></svg>
      </button>
      <button class="ps-btn icon" type="button" id="lockBtn" onclick="toggleLock()" title="Dashboard locked — click to edit">
        <svg id="lockIcon" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><rect x="3" y="11" width="18" height="11" rx="2"/><path d="M7 11V7a5 5 0 0110 0v4"/></svg>
      </button>
      <!-- Edit controls (hidden when locked) -->
      <div id="editControls" style="display:none;align-items:center;gap:8px;">
        <button class="ps-btn" type="button" onclick="resetLayout()">
          <svg fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M3 12a9 9 0 109-9 9.75 9.75 0 00-6.74 2.74L3 8"/><path d="M3 3v5h5"/></svg>
          Reset
        </button>
        <button class="ps-btn" type="button" onclick="saveLayout()">
          <svg fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M19 21H5a2 2 0 01-2-2V5a2 2 0 012-2h11l5 5v11a2 2 0 01-2 2z"/><polyline points="17 21 17 13 7 13 7 21"/><polyline points="7 3 7 8 15 8"/></svg>
          Save Layout

<script>
'use strict';

// ============================================================
// 1.  FEATURE DETECTION
// ============================================================
if (typeof runQuery !== 'function' && typeof runQueryAsync !== 'function') {
  document.body.innerHTML = '<div style="padding:40px;font-family:sans-serif;color:#506872;"><h2>Not running inside Fishbowl</h2><p>This report requires the Fishbowl embedded browser.</p></div>';
  throw new Error('Fishbowl API not available');

// ============================================================
// 2.  CONSTANTS & HELPERS
// ============================================================
// Workspace DS palette (matches Production_Scheduling_v1.2 tokens).
const DS = { blue:'#2d9cdb', blueDark:'#1e7bb4', teal:'#4CA585', magenta:'#845EEB', yellow:'#F7C23A',
             success:'#1B7A46', warning:'#B26A14', negative:'#C43046', neutral:'#506872' };
const COLOR_PALETTE = [DS.blue, '#F69133', DS.magenta, DS.yellow, '#802842', DS.neutral, '#8FA1A7', '#0B3140', '#CBE5FB', '#DBE8E1'];
const FY_START = parseInt(getProperty('BI_FY_START_MONTH','7')) || 7;
const CURR = (function(){ try { return currencyLocale(); } catch(e){ return {locale:'en-US',symbol:'$'}; } })();
const SYM = CURR.symbol || '$';
const LOC = CURR.locale || 'en-US';
const DEBUG_MODE = (function(){ try { const v = getProperty('BI_SHOW_DEBUG','false'); return v === 'true' || v === true; } catch(e){ return false; } })();

// compactFrac (compact mode) = decimals at EVERY magnitude (M / k / units).
// Default null keeps the compact look for badges/charts/tables (M=2, k=1,
// whole units). KPI tiles pass 3 so large values read $7.283M / $40.712k and
// sub-1,000 values show 2–3 decimals ($302.50, $302.456).
function fmt$(v, compact=false, compactFrac=null) {
  const n = parseFloat(v||0), neg = n < 0, abs = Math.abs(n);
  const mF = compactFrac==null ? 2 : compactFrac;
  const kF = compactFrac==null ? 1 : compactFrac;
  let s;
  if (compact) {
    if (abs >= 1e6) s = SYM + (abs/1e6).toFixed(mF) + 'M';
    else if (abs >= 1e3) s = SYM + (abs/1e3).toFixed(kF) + 'k';
    else s = SYM + abs.toLocaleString(LOC, {minimumFractionDigits:(compactFrac==null?0:2), maximumFractionDigits:(compactFrac==null?0:compactFrac)});
  } else {
    s = SYM + abs.toLocaleString(LOC, {minimumFractionDigits:2, maximumFractionDigits:2});
  }
  return neg ? '-'+s : s;
}
// NOTE: purchasing percents (on_time_percent) are already 0–100 values
// from SQL — no ×100 here (unlike the sales dashboard's fraction-based
// margins).
function fmtPct(v) { return parseFloat(v||0).toFixed(1)+'%'; }
function fmtNum(v) { return parseInt(v||0).toLocaleString(); }
function fmtDate(s) { if (!s) return '—'; return moment(s).format('D MMM YY'); }
function escSQL(v) { if (v==null) return ''; return String(v).replace(/'/g,"''"); }

const KPI_ICONS = {
  spend:       '<path d="M12 8c-1.657 0-3 .895-3 2s1.343 2 3 2 3 .895 3 2-1.343 2-3 2m0-8c1.11 0 2.08.402 2.599 1M12 8V7m0 1v8m0 0v1m0-1c-1.11 0-2.08-.402-2.599-1M21 12a9 9 0 11-18 0 9 9 0 0118 0z"/>',
  invspend:    '<path d="M20 7l-8-4-8 4m16 0l-8 4m8-4v10l-8 4m0-10L4 7m8 4v10M4 7v10l8 4"/>',
  noninvspend: '<path d="M8 7h12m0 0l-4-4m4 4l-4 4m0 6H4m0 0l4 4m-4-4l4-4"/>',
  pocount:     '<path d="M9 12h6m-6 4h6m2 5H7a2 2 0 01-2-2V5a2 2 0 012-2h5.586a1 1 0 01.707.293l5.414 5.414a1 1 0 01.293.707V19a2 2 0 01-2 2z"/>',
  avgpo:       '<path d="M7 12l3-3 3 3 4-4M8 21l4-4 4 4M3 4h18M4 4h16v12a1 1 0 01-1 1H5a1 1 0 01-1-1V4z"/>',
  leadtime:    '<path d="M12 8v4l3 3m6-3a9 9 0 11-18 0 9 9 0 0118 0z"/>'
};
// Badge strip metadata — `k` is the merged KPI row (getKPIMetrics fields +
// avg_lead_time from getAverageLeadTime).
const BADGE_META = {
  spend:       { label:'Total Spend', color:DS.blue,    icon:KPI_ICONS.spend,       get:(k)=>fmt$(parseFloat(k.total_spend||0),true) },
  invspend:    { label:'Inventory',   color:DS.success, icon:KPI_ICONS.invspend,    get:(k)=>fmt$(parseFloat(k.inventory_spend||0),true) },
  noninvspend: { label:'Other',       color:DS.neutral, icon:KPI_ICONS.noninvspend, get:(k)=>fmt$(parseFloat(k.total_spend||0)-parseFloat(k.inventory_spend||0),true) },
  pocount:     { label:'POs Received',color:DS.magenta, icon:KPI_ICONS.pocount,     get:(k)=>fmtNum(parseInt(k.po_count||0)) },
  avgpo:       { label:'Avg PO',      color:DS.warning, icon:KPI_ICONS.avgpo,       get:(k)=>fmt$(parseFloat(k.avg_po_value||0),true) },
  leadtime:    { label:'Lead Time',   color:null,       icon:KPI_ICONS.leadtime,
    get:(k)=>{ const lt = k.avg_lead_time; return (lt == null || isNaN(parseFloat(lt))) ? '—' : Math.round(parseFloat(lt)) + ' days'; },
    colorFn:(k)=>{ const lt = parseFloat(k.avg_lead_time); if (isNaN(lt)) return DS.neutral; return lt <= 7 ? DS.success : lt <= 14 ? DS.warning : DS.negative; } }
};
let _badgeConfig = ['spend','invspend','noninvspend','pocount','avgpo','leadtime'];

let _dsDebugOn = false;   // user pref (Settings ▸ Show debug console) — set at init

function debugLog(message, type = 'info') {
  if (!DEBUG_MODE && !_dsDebugOn) return;
  const ts = new Date().toLocaleTimeString();
  const logDiv = document.getElementById('debugLog');
  if (!logDiv) return;
  if (logDiv.querySelector('span[style*="italic"]')) logDiv.innerHTML = '';
  const colors = { info:'#60a5fa', success:'#34d399', warning:'#F7C23A', error:'#f87171', click:'#c084fc' };

  logDiv.appendChild(entry);
  logDiv.scrollTop = logDiv.scrollHeight;
}

// ── FB-LIB DEBUG DRAWER (mirrors Production_Scheduling_v1.2) ──
// mountDebugDrawer() creates a fixed bottom drawer containing #debugLog.
// applyDebugDrawer(show) shows/expands or hides it based on the user's
// dsDebug preference. Because the drawer is fixed-position, the app shell
// needs to shrink by its current height — the observer writes a CSS
// custom property --debug-drawer-h that .app-col reads.
let _debugApi = null;
function applyDebugDrawer(showIt) {
  if (!window.FBLib || !FBLib.Common) return;
  if (!_debugApi) _debugApi = FBLib.Common.mountDebugDrawer();
  if (!_debugApi) return;
  if (showIt) { _debugApi.show(); _debugApi.expand(); }
  else _debugApi.hide();
  if (_debugApi.element) observeDebugDrawer(_debugApi.element);
}
function observeDebugDrawer(el) {
  if (!el || el._observed) return;
  el._observed = true;
  const apply = () => {
    const visible = el.classList.contains('is-visible');
    const open    = el.classList.contains('is-open');
    const h = (visible && open) ? Math.ceil(el.getBoundingClientRect().height) : (visible ? 40 : 0);
    document.body.style.setProperty('--debug-drawer-h', h + 'px');
  };
  apply();
  if (typeof ResizeObserver === 'function') {
    try { new ResizeObserver(apply).observe(el); } catch (_) {}
  }
  try { new MutationObserver(apply).observe(el, { attributes: true, attributeFilter: ['class'] }); } catch (_) {}
}

async function runQueryP(sql) {
  if (typeof runQueryAsync === 'function') {
    const r = await runQueryAsync(sql);
    return Array.isArray(r) ? r : [];
  }
  try { const p = JSON.parse(runQuery(sql)); return Array.isArray(p) ? p : []; } catch(e) { return []; }
}

async function runQueryLogged(label, sql) {
  debugLog(`${label}: executing query`, 'info');
  console.log(`${label} Query:`, sql);
  try {
    const r = await runQueryP(sql);
    debugLog(`${label}: returned ${r.length} row(s)`, r.length ? 'success' : 'warning');
    return r;
  } catch(e) {
    debugLog(`${label}: ERROR — ${e.message}`, 'error');
    throw e;
  }
}

// ============================================================
// 4.  FILTER STATE + DATE RANGE
// ------------------------------------------------------------
// F replaces the old <select> DOM reads. The filter strip
// (renderFilterbar, section 16) renders from it; every query
// builder reads it.
// ============================================================
const F = {
  datePreset: '90',
  customStart: '', customEnd: '',
  vendor: [], category: [], abc: [], location: []
};
const SD_RANGES = [
  ['today','Today'], ['this_week','This Week'], ['this_month','This Month'], ['last_month','Last Month'],
  ['30','Last 30 Days'], ['60','Last 60 Days'], ['90','Last 90 Days'], ['180','Last 6 Months'], ['365','Last Year'],
  ['this_quarter','This Quarter'], ['last_quarter','Last Quarter'],
  ['current_fy','Current Financial Year'], ['last_fy','Last Financial Year'],
  ['current_cy','Current Calendar Year'], ['last_cy','Last Calendar Year'], ['custom','Custom Range']
];
let _openDrop = null;    // which .fdrop panel is open ('date' | dim key | null)
let _filterOpts = { vendors: [], categories: [], locations: [] };

function sdRangeLabel() {
  if (F.datePreset === 'custom' && F.customStart && F.customEnd)
    return moment(F.customStart).format('D MMM YY') + ' – ' + moment(F.customEnd).format('D MMM YY');
  const e = SD_RANGES.find(r => r[0] === F.datePreset);
  return e ? e[1] : 'Date range';
}

function getDateRange() {
  const sel = F.datePreset;
  if (sel === 'custom') return { start: F.customStart || null, end: F.customEnd || null };

  const now = moment();
  const y = now.year(), m = now.month();

  if (sel === 'today')       return { start: now.format('YYYY-MM-DD'), end: now.format('YYYY-MM-DD') };
  if (sel === 'this_week')   return { start: now.clone().startOf('isoWeek').format('YYYY-MM-DD'), end: now.clone().endOf('isoWeek').format('YYYY-MM-DD') };
  if (sel === 'this_month')  return { start: now.clone().startOf('month').format('YYYY-MM-DD'), end: now.clone().endOf('month').format('YYYY-MM-DD') };
  if (sel === 'last_month')  { const lm = now.clone().subtract(1,'month'); return { start: lm.startOf('month').format('YYYY-MM-DD'), end: lm.endOf('month').format('YYYY-MM-DD') }; }
  if (!isNaN(parseInt(sel))) { const d = parseInt(sel); return { start: now.clone().subtract(d,'days').format('YYYY-MM-DD'), end: now.format('YYYY-MM-DD') }; }
  if (sel === 'this_quarter'){ const qs = now.clone().startOf('quarter'); return { start: qs.format('YYYY-MM-DD'), end: qs.clone().endOf('quarter').format('YYYY-MM-DD') }; }
  if (sel === 'last_quarter'){ const lqs = now.clone().subtract(1,'quarter').startOf('quarter'); return { start: lqs.format('YYYY-MM-DD'), end: lqs.clone().endOf('quarter').format('YYYY-MM-DD') }; }

  // FY helpers
  function fyDates(offset) {
    const fsm = FY_START;
    const curMonth = now.month() + 1;
    let fyY = (curMonth >= fsm ? y : y-1) - offset;
    let endM, endY;
    if (fsm === 1) { endM = 12; endY = fyY; }
    else { endM = fsm-1; endY = fyY+1; }
    const end = moment([endY, endM-1, 1]).endOf('month');
    return { start: `${fyY}-${String(fsm).padStart(2,'0')}-01`, end: end.format('YYYY-MM-DD') };
  }
  if (sel === 'current_fy') return fyDates(0);
  if (sel === 'last_fy')    return fyDates(1);
  if (sel === 'current_cy') return { start: `${y}-01-01`, end: `${y}-12-31` };
  if (sel === 'last_cy')    return { start: `${y-1}-01-01`, end: `${y-1}-12-31` };
  return fyDates(0);
}

// Date condition for dated (spend / receipt-history) queries. The default
// column mirrors the old report: postpo.DateCreated. Per-query overrides
// (po.dateIssued for the PO Status donut, ri.dateReceived for the lead-time
// trend) pass a different column, exactly as the old report varied them.
function getDateCondition(dateCol) {
  const col = dateCol || 'postpo.DateCreated';
  const r = getDateRange();
  if (!r.start || !r.end) return `${col} >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 365 DAY)`;
  return `${col} >= '${r.start}' AND ${col} <= '${r.end} 23:59:59'`;
}

}

// ============================================================
// 5.  SQL CONSTANTS & FILTER CONDITIONS
// ------------------------------------------------------------
// Ported near-verbatim from the original Purchasing_Dashboard.htm.
// PO_BASE_JOIN is the received-spend stack (postpoitem only exists once
// a PO has been received, which automatically excludes Bids and
// un-received POs from spend numbers). OPEN_PO_JOIN is the open-book
// stack for the snapshot tiles.
// ============================================================
// Donut slice budget. Past ~10 wedges the slivers are unreadable, but
// dropping them with a SQL LIMIT made the chart under-report — the wedges
// no longer summed to the spend KPI. Keep the top N and fold the rest into
// one clickable "Other" slice instead.
const PIE_TOP_SLICES = 9;       // real slices; "Other" is the 10th

const PO_BASE_JOIN = `
  FROM postpoitem
  JOIN postpo ON postpoitem.postpoid = postpo.id
  JOIN poitem ON postpoitem.poitemid = poitem.id
  LEFT JOIN part ON poitem.partid = part.id
  LEFT JOIN ProductToTree ON ProductToTree.ProductId = part.Id
  LEFT JOIN ProductTree ON ProductTree.Id = ProductToTree.ProductTreeId
  JOIN po ON poitem.poid = po.id
  JOIN vendor ON po.vendorid = vendor.id
  JOIN locationgroup ON po.locationgroupid = locationgroup.id`;

const OPEN_PO_JOIN = `
  FROM po
  JOIN poitem ON poitem.poid = po.id
  LEFT JOIN part ON poitem.partid = part.id
  LEFT JOIN ProductToTree ON ProductToTree.ProductId = part.Id
  LEFT JOIN ProductTree ON ProductTree.Id = ProductToTree.ProductTreeId
  JOIN vendor ON po.vendorid = vendor.id
  JOIN locationgroup ON po.locationgroupid = locationgroup.id`;

// Dimension fragments — the exact fragments the old buildFilterConditions
// emitted (vendor.id= / ProductTree.Name= / part.abcCode= / locationgroup.id=).
// Callers that cannot join a dimension pass {category:false, abc:false} etc.
// Multi-select filter helpers — each dimension in F is an array of selected
// string values; an empty array means "All" (no filter, the old '%' semantic).
// array → " AND col IN (n,n)"  (numeric); '' when empty
function sdInNum(col, arr){ const v=(arr||[]).map(x=>parseInt(x)).filter(n=>!isNaN(n)); return v.length ? ` AND ${col} IN (${v.join(',')})` : ''; }
// array → " AND col IN ('a','b')" (string, escaped); '' when empty
function sdInStr(col, arr){ const v=(arr||[]).filter(x=>x!=null && x!==''); return v.length ? ` AND ${col} IN (${v.map(x=>`'${escSQL(x)}'`).join(',')})` : ''; }
// coerce any saved value (array | '%' | '' | single | null) to a string array
function toArr(v){ if(Array.isArray(v)) return v.map(String); if(v==null||v==='%'||v==='') return []; return [String(v)]; }

function dimConditions(opts = {}) {
  let s = '';
  if (opts.vendor   !== false) s += sdInNum('vendor.id', F.vendor);
  if (opts.category !== false) s += sdInStr('ProductTree.Name', F.category);
  if (opts.abc      !== false) s += sdInStr('part.abcCode', F.abc);
  if (opts.location !== false) s += sdInNum('locationgroup.id', F.location);
  return s;
}

function buildFilterConditions(dateCondOverride) {
  return `WHERE ${dateCondOverride || getDateCondition()}` + dimConditions();
}

// ── KPI ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// `k` is the merged row: getKPIMetrics fields + avg_lead_time.
function _kpiCompute(kpiKey, k) {
  const spend  = parseFloat(k.total_spend     || 0);
  const inv    = parseFloat(k.inventory_spend || 0);
  const pos    = parseInt(k.po_count          || 0);
  const avgpo  = parseFloat(k.avg_po_value    || 0);
  const lead   = (k.avg_lead_time == null || isNaN(parseFloat(k.avg_lead_time))) ? null : parseFloat(k.avg_lead_time);
  let raw, val, label, color;
  // `tone` picks the shared .kpi-chip tint (fb-styles §28); `color` is kept
  // for the topbar badge strip, which still colours its value text.
  let tone;
  switch (kpiKey) {
    case 'spend':       raw = spend;     val = fmt$(spend, true, 3);     label = 'Total Spend';     color = DS.blue;     tone = 'tone-blue'; break;
    case 'invspend':    raw = inv;       val = fmt$(inv, true, 3);       label = 'Inventory Spend'; color = DS.success;  tone = 'tone-success'; break;
    case 'noninvspend': raw = spend-inv; val = fmt$(spend-inv, true, 3); label = 'Other Spend';     color = DS.neutral;  tone = 'tone-neutral'; break;
    case 'pocount':     raw = pos;       val = fmtNum(pos);           label = 'POs Received';    color = DS.magenta;  tone = 'tone-purple'; break;
    case 'avgpo':       raw = avgpo;     val = fmt$(avgpo, true, 3);     label = 'Avg PO Value';    color = DS.warning;  tone = 'tone-warning'; break;
    case 'leadtime':    raw = lead ?? 0; val = lead == null ? '—' : Math.round(lead) + ' days'; label = 'Avg Lead Time';
      color = lead == null ? DS.neutral : lead <= 7 ? DS.success : lead <= 14 ? DS.warning : DS.negative;
      tone  = lead == null ? 'tone-neutral' : lead <= 7 ? 'tone-success' : lead <= 14 ? 'tone-warning' : 'tone-negative'; break;
    default:            raw = 0;         val = '—';                   label = kpiKey;            color = '#506872';   tone = 'tone-neutral';
  }
  // full = exact value for the tile hover tooltip (compact tiles can look
  // identical when they differ only in the sub-$1,000 range).
  const full = (kpiKey==='spend'||kpiKey==='invspend'||kpiKey==='noninvspend'||kpiKey==='avgpo') ? fmt$(raw) : val;
  return { raw, val, label, color, tone, full };
}

async function fetchKpiRow() {
  const [kpiRows, ltRows] = await Promise.all([Q.kpis(), Q.leadtime()]);
  const k = Object.assign({}, (kpiRows && kpiRows[0]) || {});
  k.avg_lead_time = (ltRows && ltRows[0]) ? ltRows[0].avg_lead_time : null;
  return k;
}

async function renderKPI(el, kpiKey, cfg = {}) {
  debugLog(`Rendering KPI: ${kpiKey}`, 'info');
  renderSkeleton(el);
  const k = await fetchKpiRow();
  const cur = _kpiCompute(kpiKey, k);

  debugLog(`KPI ${kpiKey}: ${cur.val}`, 'success');
  // Shared icon-chip anatomy (fb-styles §28): chip carries the tone,
  // value stays neutral dark.
  const iconPath = KPI_ICONS[kpiKey] || '';
  el.innerHTML = `<div class="kpi-root">
    <div class="kpi-chip ${cur.tone}"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">${iconPath}</svg></div>
    <div class="kpi-text">
      <div class="kpi-lbl">${cur.label}</div>
      <div class="kpi-val" title="${cur.full}"><span>${cur.val}</span></div>
    </div>
  </div>`;
  return null;
}

// ── Time-series (bar or line; generic x/value keys) ──────────
// opts: { xKey, valueKey, fmt:'currency'|'days'|'count', xTickFmt,
//         tipTitleFmt, tipLabel, tipExtra(meta), clickable(d) }
async function renderTimeSeries(el, cfg, dataFn, opts = {}) {
  const mode = (cfg && cfg.chartType) || 'bar';
  debugLog(`Rendering time series (mode: ${mode})`, 'info');
  renderSkeleton(el);
  const raw = await dataFn();
  if (!raw.length) { debugLog('Time series: no data for period', 'warning'); el.innerHTML = '<div class="tile-skel"><span class="tile-skel-lbl">No data for period</span></div>'; return; }
  debugLog(`Time series: rendering ${raw.length} points`, 'success');

  el.innerHTML = '';
  const W = el.clientWidth, H = el.clientHeight;
  if (W < 80 || H < 50) return;

  const xKey = opts.xKey || 'month';
  const vKey = opts.valueKey || 'total_spend';
  const fmtKind = opts.fmt || 'currency';
  const fmtV = v => fmtKind === 'currency' ? fmt$(v) : fmtKind === 'days' ? parseFloat(v).toFixed(1) + ' days' : fmtNum(v);

  const m    = { top:12, right:18, bottom:42, left:70 };
  const iw   = W - m.left - m.right;
  const ih   = H - m.top  - m.bottom;
  if (iw < 20 || ih < 20) return;

  const data = raw.map(d => ({ x: d[xKey], value: parseFloat(d[vKey]||0), meta: d }));

  };

  if (mode === 'bar') {
    svg.selectAll('.ts-bar').data(data).join('rect').attr('class','ts-bar')
      .attr('x',d=>xBand(d.x)).attr('y',d=>yV(d.value))

      .on('click', opts.clickable ? ((ev,d)=>{ hideTip(); opts.clickable(d); }) : null);
  } else {
    const linePath = d3.line().x(d=>xBand(d.x)+xBand.bandwidth()/2).y(d=>yV(d.value)).curve(d3.curveMonotoneX);

      .attr('d', d3.area().x(d=>xBand(d.x)+xBand.bandwidth()/2).y0(ih).y1(d=>yV(d.value)).curve(d3.curveMonotoneX));
    svg.selectAll('.ts-dot').data(data).join('circle').attr('class','ts-dot')
      .attr('cx',d=>xBand(d.x)+xBand.bandwidth()/2).attr('cy',d=>yV(d.value))
      .attr('r',4).attr('fill','white').attr('stroke',DS.blue).attr('stroke-width',2)
      .style('cursor', opts.clickable ? 'pointer' : 'default')
      .on('mouseover',(ev,d)=>showTip(ev,tipHtml(d)))
      .on('mousemove',moveTip).on('mouseout',hideTip)
      .on('click', opts.clickable ? ((ev,d)=>{ hideTip(); opts.clickable(d); }) : null);
  }

  // Axes
  svg.append('g').attr('class','axis').attr('transform',`translate(0,${ih})`).call(d3.axisBottom(xBand).tickFormat(d=>moment(d).format(opts.xTickFmt || 'MMM YY'))).selectAll('text').attr('transform','rotate(-40)').style('text-anchor','end');

async function renderHorizBar(el, dataFn, opts={}) {

  if (!raw.length) { debugLog('Horizontal bar: no data for period', 'warning'); el.innerHTML = '<div class="tile-skel"><span class="tile-skel-lbl">No data for period</span></div>'; return; }
  debugLog(`Horizontal bar: rendering ${raw.length} rows`, 'success');

  el.innerHTML = '';
  const W = el.clientWidth, H = el.clientHeight;
  if (W < 80 || H < 50) return;

  const nameKey = opts.nameKey || 'name';
  const vKey    = opts.valueKey || 'value';
  const data = raw.map(d => ({ name: d[nameKey], value: parseFloat(d[vKey] || 0), meta: d }));
  const m  = { top:6, right:84, bottom:18, left: Math.min(120, W*0.32) };
  const iw = W - m.left - m.right;
  const ih = H - m.top  - m.bottom;
  if (iw < 20 || ih < 20) return;

  const fmtV = v => opts.fmt === 'count' ? fmtNum(v) : opts.fmt === 'percent' ? parseFloat(v).toFixed(1)+'%' : fmt$(v);
  const fmtVCompact = v => opts.fmt === 'count' ? fmtNum(v) : opts.fmt === 'percent' ? parseFloat(v).toFixed(1)+'%' : fmt$(v, true);

  const svg = d3.select(el).append('svg').attr('width',W).attr('height',H).style('overflow','hidden').append('g').attr('transform',`translate(${m.left},${m.top})`);

  const minV = Math.min(0, d3.min(data,d=>d.value) || 0);
  const x = d3.scaleLinear().domain([minV, d3.max(data,d=>d.value)||1]).nice().range([0,iw]);
  const y = d3.scaleBand().domain(data.map(d=>d.name)).range([0,ih]).padding(0.22);

  svg.append('g').selectAll('line').data(x.ticks(4)).join('line').attr('class','grid-line').attr('x1',d=>x(d)).attr('x2',d=>x(d)).attr('y1',0).attr('y2',ih);

  svg.selectAll('.bar').data(data).join('rect').attr('class','bar')
    .attr('x',d=>x(Math.min(0, d.value))).attr('y',d=>y(d.name))
    .attr('width',d=>Math.max(1, Math.abs(x(d.value)-x(0)))).attr('height',y.bandwidth())
    .attr('rx',3)
    .attr('fill',(d,i)=> opts.colorFn ? opts.colorFn(d) : COLOR_PALETTE[i % COLOR_PALETTE.length])
    .style('cursor', opts.clickable ? 'pointer' : 'default')
    .on('mouseover',(ev,d)=>{
      const extra = opts.tipExtra ? opts.tipExtra(d.meta) : '';
      const hint  = opts.clickable ? '<br><em>Click to drill in</em>' : '';
      showTip(ev, `<strong>${d.name}</strong><br>${fmtV(d.value)}${extra}${hint}`);
    })
    .on('mousemove',moveTip).on('mouseout',hideTip)
    .on('click', opts.clickable ? ((ev,d) => { hideTip(); opts.clickable(d); }) : null);

  svg.selectAll('.val-lbl').data(data).join('text').attr('class','val-lbl')
    .attr('x',d=>x(Math.max(0, d.value))+4).attr('y',d=>y(d.name)+y.bandwidth()/2)
    .attr('dy','0.35em').style('fill','#8FA1A7').style('font-size','9px')
    .text(d => fmtVCompact(d.value));

  svg.append('g').attr('class','axis').attr('transform',`translate(0,${ih})`).call(d3.axisBottom(x).ticks(4).tickFormat(d=>opts.fmt==='percent' ? d+'%' : opts.fmt==='count' ? d3.format('.2s')(d) : '$'+d3.format('.2s')(d)));
  svg.append('g').attr('class','axis').call(d3.axisLeft(y).tickFormat(d=>String(d).length>15?String(d).slice(0,14)+'…':d)).selectAll('text').style('font-size','10px');

  return { columns:[{key:'name',label:'Name'},{key:'value',label:(opts.valueLabel||'Value')}], rows: data.map(d=>({name:d.name,value:d.value})) };
}

// ── Donut (generic name/value keys) ──────────────────────────
// opts: { nameKey, valueKey, fmtVal(v), colorMap, clickable(datum) }
async function renderDonut(el, dataFn, opts = {}) {
  debugLog(`Rendering donut chart`, 'info');
  renderSkeleton(el);
  const raw = await dataFn();
  if (!raw.length) { debugLog('Donut: no data for period', 'warning'); el.innerHTML = '<div class="tile-skel"><span class="tile-skel-lbl">No data for period</span></div>'; return; }
  debugLog(`Donut: rendering ${raw.length} segments`, 'success');

  el.innerHTML = '';
  const W = el.clientWidth, H = el.clientHeight;
  if (W < 80 || H < 50) return;

  const nameKey = opts.nameKey || 'name';
  const vKey    = opts.valueKey || 'value';
  const fmtVal  = opts.fmtVal || (v => fmt$(v));
  const fmtValCompact = opts.fmtVal || (v => fmt$(v, true));

  // Drop only the exact zeros (an empty PO status shouldn't occupy a legend
  // row). Negatives are KEPT — a category that nets negative on credits used
  // to vanish silently, which made the donut under-report against the spend
  // KPI. Percentages run against the true total; the wedge geometry clamps
  // at zero because d3.pie cannot draw a negative angle.
  const data  = raw.map(d => ({ name: d[nameKey], value: parseFloat(d[vKey]||0), meta: d, isOther: !!d.isOther, members: d.members })).filter(d => d.value !== 0);
  if (!data.length) { el.innerHTML = '<div class="tile-skel"><span class="tile-skel-lbl">No data for period</span></div>'; return; }
  const total = d3.sum(data,d=>d.value) || 1;
  const csz   = Math.min(W*0.48, H-4, 220);
  const r     = csz/2;
  const palette = d3.scaleOrdinal().domain(data.map(d=>d.name)).range(COLOR_PALETTE);
  const color   = name => (opts.colorMap && opts.colorMap[name]) || palette(name);

  const wrap = d3.select(el).append('div').style('display','flex').style('align-items','center').style('gap','10px').style('height','100%').style('overflow','hidden').style('padding','4px 8px');
  const svgWrap = wrap.append('div').style('flex-shrink','0');
  const legWrap = wrap.append('div').style('flex','1').style('overflow-y','auto').style('min-width','0');

  const svg = svgWrap.append('svg').attr('width',csz).attr('height',csz).append('g').attr('transform',`translate(${r},${r})`);
  const arc     = d3.arc().innerRadius(r*.44).outerRadius(r*.84);
  const arcHov  = d3.arc().innerRadius(r*.44).outerRadius(r*.92);
  const pie     = d3.pie().value(d=>Math.max(0,d.value)).sort(null);

  svg.selectAll('path').data(pie(data)).join('path').attr('d',arc)
    .attr('fill',d=>color(d.data.name)).attr('stroke','white').attr('stroke-width',2)
    .style('cursor', opts.clickable ? 'pointer' : 'default')
    .on('mouseover', function(ev,d){
      d3.select(this).transition().duration(100).attr('d',arcHov);
      // The Other wedge names what it swallowed — the grouping is never a black box.
      const members = d.data.members ? `<br><span style="opacity:.7">${d.data.members.join(', ')}</span>` : '';
      showTip(ev,`<strong>${d.data.name}</strong><br>${fmtVal(d.data.value)}<br>${(d.data.value/total*100).toFixed(1)}% of total${members}${opts.clickable?'<br><em>Click to drill in</em>':''}`);
    })
    .on('mousemove',moveTip).on('mouseout', function(){ d3.select(this).transition().duration(100).attr('d',arc); hideTip(); })
    .on('click', opts.clickable ? ((ev,d) => { hideTip(); opts.clickable(d.data); }) : null);

  svg.selectAll('text.pct').data(pie(data)).join('text').attr('class','pct')
    .attr('transform',d=>`translate(${arc.centroid(d)})`).attr('text-anchor','middle')
    .style('fill','white').style('font-size',Math.max(8,Math.min(11,r/5))+'px').style('font-weight','700').style('pointer-events','none')
    .text(d=>(d.data.value/total*100)>6?(d.data.value/total*100).toFixed(0)+'%':'');

  data.forEach(d=>{
    const row = legWrap.append('div').style('display','flex').style('align-items','center').style('gap','6px').style('margin-bottom','5px').style('font-size','10px');
    if (opts.clickable) row.style('cursor','pointer').on('click', () => opts.clickable(d));
    row.append('div').style('width','9px').style('height','9px').style('background',color(d.name)).style('border-radius','2px').style('flex-shrink','0');
    row.append('span').style('color','#506872').style('line-height','1.3').text(`${d.name} (${fmtValCompact(d.value)})`);
  });

  // Export `fullRows` when the data function supplied one, so a rolled-up
  // "Other" wedge still exports every underlying group, not the summary row.
  const exportSrc = raw.fullRows || raw;
  return {
    columns:[{key:'name',label:'Name'},{key:'value',label:(opts.valueLabel||'Value')}],
    rows: exportSrc.map(d => ({ name: d[nameKey] != null ? d[nameKey] : d.name, value: parseFloat((d[vKey] != null ? d[vKey] : d.value) || 0) }))
  };
}

// ── Sortable table ───────────────────────────────────────────
async function renderSortableTable(el, dataFn, columns) {
  debugLog(`Rendering sortable table (${columns.length} columns)`, 'info');
  renderSkeleton(el);
  const raw = await dataFn();
  debugLog(`Sortable table: ${raw.length} rows`, raw.length ? 'success' : 'warning');
  el.innerHTML = '';

  let data = [...raw], sortKey = null, sortDir = 'asc';

  const scroll = document.createElement('div');
  scroll.style.cssText = 'height:100%;overflow:auto;';
  el.appendChild(scroll);

  const tbl  = document.createElement('table'); tbl.className = 'data-table';
  const thead = document.createElement('thead');
  const hrow  = document.createElement('tr');

  columns.forEach(col => {
    const th = document.createElement('th');
    th.innerHTML = `${col.label} <span style="color:#C6D0D4;font-size:8px;">↕</span>`;
    th.addEventListener('click', () => {
      if (sortKey === col.key) sortDir = sortDir === 'asc' ? 'desc' : 'asc';
      else { sortKey = col.key; sortDir = 'asc'; }
      data.sort((a,b) => {
        const av = a[col.key], bv = b[col.key];
        if (col.fmt === 'date' || col.fmt === 'monthyear') {
          const at = av ? new Date(av).getTime() : 0;
          const bt = bv ? new Date(bv).getTime() : 0;
          return sortDir === 'asc' ? at - bt : bt - at;
        }
        const an = parseFloat(av), bn = parseFloat(bv);
        if (!isNaN(an) && !isNaN(bn)) return sortDir === 'asc' ? an - bn : bn - an;
        return sortDir === 'asc' ? String(av).localeCompare(String(bv)) : String(bv).localeCompare(String(av));
      });
      hrow.querySelectorAll('th span').forEach(s => s.innerHTML = '<span style="color:#C6D0D4;font-size:8px;">↕</span>');
      th.querySelector('span').innerHTML = `<span style="color:#506872;font-size:8px;">${sortDir==='asc'?'↑':'↓'}</span>`;
      renderRows();
    });
    hrow.appendChild(th);
  });
  thead.appendChild(hrow);

  const tbody = document.createElement('tbody');

  function renderRows() {
    tbody.innerHTML = '';
    if (!data.length) {
      const tr = document.createElement('tr');
      tr.innerHTML = `<td colspan="${columns.length}" style="text-align:center;color:#8FA1A7;padding:20px;">No data for period</td>`;
      tbody.appendChild(tr); return;
    }
    data.forEach(row => {
      const tr = document.createElement('tr');
      columns.forEach(col => {
        const td = document.createElement('td');
        const v  = row[col.key];
        if      (col.fmt === 'currency') td.textContent = fmt$(v);
        else if (col.fmt === 'percent')  td.textContent = fmtPct(v);
        else if (col.fmt === 'count')    td.textContent = fmtNum(v);
        else if (col.fmt === 'date')     td.textContent = fmtDate(v);
        else if (col.fmt === 'monthyear') td.textContent = v ? moment(v).format('MMM YYYY') : '—';
        else if (col.fmt === 'polink')   { td.innerHTML = `<span class="order-link" onclick="openModule('Purchase Order','${escSQL(String(v))}')">${v||'—'}</span>`; }
        else td.textContent = v ?? '—';
        tr.appendChild(td);
      });
      tbody.appendChild(tr);
    });
  }

  tbl.appendChild(thead); tbl.appendChild(tbody);
  scroll.appendChild(tbl);
  renderRows();

  return { columns: columns.map(c=>({key:c.key,label:c.label})), rows: raw };
}

      `<button class="chart-toggle-btn opt-toggle-btn ${cur===m.v?'active':''}" data-opt-key="${group.key}" data-opt-val="${m.v}" title="${m.label}" style="width:auto;padding:0 6px;">${m.label}</button>`

  // Export button — reuses .widget-remove base sizing via that class, with the
  // .widget-export add-on for its own (non-red) styling + lock exemption.
  const exportBtnHTML = `<button class="widget-remove widget-export" title="Export this tile to CSV" disabled>

function addWidget(type, cfg={}, pos={}) {
  debugLog(`Adding widget: ${type}`, 'info');
  const reg = WIDGET_REGISTRY[type];
  if (!reg) { debugLog(`Unknown widget type: ${type}`, 'error'); return null; }

  // Seed a default chart type so time-series tiles that keep a non-bar default
  // (e.g. leadtime-trend → line) render correctly before the user ever toggles.
  if (reg.hasChartToggle && cfg.chartType == null) {
    cfg = { ...cfg, chartType: reg.defaultChartType || (reg.toggleModes ? reg.toggleModes[0] : 'bar') };
  }

  const isKpi = type.startsWith('kpi-');
  const minW  = isKpi ? 2 : 1;
  const minH  = 2;
  const wantW = pos.w || reg.defaultW;
  // KPI stat tiles are FIXED at two 40px grid rows (~80px — same as the
  // Production Scheduling .kpi stat panels) — saved heights are ignored
  // and vertical resizing is blocked via maxH.
  const wantH = isKpi ? 2 : (pos.h || reg.defaultH);

  const opts = {
    w: Math.max(wantW, minW),
    h: Math.max(wantH, minH),
    minW, minH,
    content: buildWidgetContent(type, cfg)
  };
  if (isKpi) opts.maxH = 2;
  if (pos.x !== undefined) opts.x = pos.x;
  if (pos.y !== undefined) opts.y = pos.y;

  const el     = grid.addWidget(opts);
  const bodyEl = el.querySelector('.widget-body');
  const state  = { type, config:{...cfg}, bodyEl, reg };
  widgetStore.set(el, state);
  el.dataset.widgetType   = type;
  el.dataset.widgetConfig = JSON.stringify(cfg);

  // NB: the export button also carries .widget-remove (for shared 24px sizing),
  // so scope the removal handler to the real remove button, else clicking
  // Export deletes the tile.
  el.querySelector('.widget-remove:not(.widget-export)').addEventListener('click', () => {
    grid.removeWidget(el); widgetStore.delete(el);
  });

  const infoBtn = el.querySelector('.info-icon-btn');
  if (infoBtn) {
    const desc = infoBtn.getAttribute('data-tooltip') || '';
    infoBtn.addEventListener('mouseenter', ev => { if (desc) showTip(ev, desc); });
    infoBtn.addEventListener('mousemove', moveTip);
    infoBtn.addEventListener('mouseleave', hideTip);
    infoBtn.addEventListener('mousedown', ev => ev.stopPropagation());
  }

  // Chart-type toggle (bar/line) — only the buttons that carry data-chart, so
  // the generic opt-toggle buttons below aren't caught by this handler.
  el.querySelectorAll('.chart-toggle-btn[data-chart]').forEach(btn => {
    btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
      state.config.chartType = btn.dataset.chart;
      el.dataset.widgetConfig = JSON.stringify(state.config);
      el.querySelectorAll('.chart-toggle-btn[data-chart]').forEach(b => b.classList.toggle('active', b.dataset.chart === state.config.chartType));
      doRender(el);
    });
  });

  // Generic secondary option toggles (§4) — per-widget, stored in state.config.
  el.querySelectorAll('.opt-toggle-btn').forEach(btn => {
    btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
      const key = btn.dataset.optKey, val = btn.dataset.optVal;
      state.config[key] = val;
      el.dataset.widgetConfig = JSON.stringify(state.config);
      el.querySelectorAll(`.opt-toggle-btn[data-opt-key="${key}"]`).forEach(b => b.classList.toggle('active', b.dataset.optVal === val));
      doRender(el);
    });
    btn.addEventListener('mousedown', ev => ev.stopPropagation());
  });

  // Export-to-CSV button (§2) — enabled by doRender once data is present.
  const expBtn = el.querySelector('.widget-export');
  if (expBtn) {
    expBtn.addEventListener('click', () => exportWidgetCSV(el));
    expBtn.addEventListener('mousedown', ev => ev.stopPropagation());
  }

  requestAnimationFrame(() => requestAnimationFrame(() => doRender(el)));
  return el;
}

async function doRender(el) {
  const state = widgetStore.get(el);
  if (!state) return;
  debugLog(`Re-rendering: ${state.type}`, 'info');
  state.bodyEl.innerHTML = '';
  const exportBtn = el.querySelector('.widget-export');
  if (exportBtn) exportBtn.disabled = true;
  try {
    const exp = await state.reg.render(state.bodyEl, state.config);
    state.exportData = (exp && exp.rows) ? exp : null;
    if (exportBtn) exportBtn.disabled = !(state.exportData && state.exportData.rows.length);
  } catch(e) {
    debugLog(`Render error (${state.type}): ${e.message}`, 'error');
    console.error('doRender error:', e);
  }
}

function rerenderAll() {
  widgetStore.forEach((_, el) => doRender(el));
}

// Per-widget CSV export (§2). Uses the payload captured in doRender.
function exportWidgetCSV(el){
  const state = widgetStore.get(el); if(!state||!state.exportData) return;
  const {columns, rows} = state.exportData;
  if(!rows||!rows.length){ showToast('Nothing to export yet','info'); return; }
  const esc = v => { v = v==null?'':String(v); return /[",\n]/.test(v) ? '"'+v.replace(/"/g,'""')+'"' : v; };
  const header = columns.map(c=>esc(c.label)).join(',');
  const body = rows.map(r=>columns.map(c=>esc(r[c.key])).join(',')).join('\n');
  const blob = new Blob([header+'\n'+body], {type:'text/csv'});
  const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
  const a = document.createElement('a'); a.href=url;
  a.download = (state.reg.title||'widget').replace(/\s+/g,'_')+'_'+moment().format('YYYY-MM-DD')+'.csv';
  // Anchor MUST be in the DOM before .click() — a detached anchor does not
  // trigger a download reliably in JxBrowser (the tile appeared to "hang").
  a.style.display='none'; document.body.appendChild(a);
  a.click();
  setTimeout(() => { document.body.removeChild(a); URL.revokeObjectURL(url); }, 0);
}

  _badgeConfig.forEach(key => {

    if (!meta) return;
    const color = meta.colorFn ? meta.colorFn(k) : meta.color;
    const val   = k && Object.keys(k).length ? meta.get(k) : '—';

    const div = document.createElement('div');
    div.className = 'kpi-badge k-' + key;
    div.dataset.badgeKey = key;

    div.innerHTML = `<span class="kpi-badge-icon" style="color:${color};"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">${meta.icon || ''}</svg></span><span class="kpi-badge-text"><span class="kpi-badge-val" style="color:${color};">${val}</span><span class="kpi-badge-lbl">${meta.label}</span></span><button class="badge-remove" title="Remove badge">✕</button>`;

    div.addEventListener('dragstart', e => {

// 15. DRILLDOWN — generic engine (donor pattern: typed sortable
//     columns, live search, CSV export, and click-to-expand PO

let _ddData = [];        // full result set (search filters a view of this)
let _ddView = [];        // currently rendered rows (post-search/sort)
let _ddCols = [];
let _ddSortCol = null;
let _ddSortDir = 'asc';

function openDrilldown(title, breadcrumb, data, columns) {
  if (!data || !Array.isArray(data)) { debugLog('openDrilldown called with invalid data', 'error'); return; }
  debugLog(`Opening drilldown: "${title}" with ${data.length} rows`, 'info');
  _ddData = data;
  _ddCols = columns;
  _ddSortCol = null;
  _ddSortDir = 'asc';
  document.getElementById('ddTitle').textContent = title;
  document.getElementById('ddSubtitle').textContent = breadcrumb;
  document.getElementById('ddSearch').value = '';
  renderDdTable(data);
  document.getElementById('drilldownModal').classList.add('show');
}

function closeDrilldown() { debugLog('Drilldown closed', 'info'); document.getElementById('drilldownModal').classList.remove('show'); }

function renderDdTable(data) {
  _ddView = data;
  const thead = document.getElementById('ddHead');
  const tbody = document.getElementById('ddBody');

  thead.innerHTML = '';
  const tr = document.createElement('tr');
  _ddCols.forEach((col, idx) => {
    const th = document.createElement('th');
    const arrow = _ddSortCol === idx ? (_ddSortDir === 'asc' ? '↑' : '↓') : '↕';
    th.innerHTML = `${col.label} <span style="opacity:.55;font-size:8px;">${arrow}</span>`;
    th.addEventListener('click', () => sortDrilldownTable(idx));
    tr.appendChild(th);
  });
  thead.appendChild(tr);

  if (!data.length) {
    tbody.innerHTML = `<tr><td colspan="${_ddCols.length}" style="text-align:center;padding:16px;color:#8FA1A7;">No rows found</td></tr>`;
    return;
  }

  tbody.innerHTML = '';
  data.forEach((row, rowIndex) => {
    const isPoRow = Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(row, 'po_num');

    const trEl = document.createElement('tr');
    trEl.dataset.rowIndex = rowIndex;
    if (isPoRow) trEl.addEventListener('click', () => togglePOLineItems(rowIndex, String(row.po_num)));

    _ddCols.forEach(col => {
      const td = document.createElement('td');
      const rawVal = row[col.key];
      const num = parseFloat(rawVal || 0);
      let text = rawVal ?? '—';

      if (col.type === 'currency')      { text = fmt$(num); if (num < 0) td.style.color = DS.negative; }
      else if (col.type === 'number')   text = fmtNum(rawVal);
      else if (col.type === 'percent')  { text = fmtPct(rawVal); td.style.fontWeight = '600'; if (num < 0) td.style.color = DS.negative; }
      else if (col.type === 'date')     text = fmtDate(rawVal);
      else if (col.format)              text = col.format(rawVal);

      if (col.key === 'po_num' && rawVal) {
        const link = document.createElement('span');
        link.className = 'order-link';
        link.textContent = rawVal;
        link.addEventListener('click', ev => { ev.stopPropagation(); openModule('Purchase Order', String(rawVal)); });
        td.appendChild(link);
      } else {
        td.textContent = text;
      }
      trEl.appendChild(td);
    });
    tbody.appendChild(trEl);
  });
}

function filterDrilldownTable() {
  const q = document.getElementById('ddSearch').value.toLowerCase();
  const filtered = _ddData.filter(row => _ddCols.some(col => String(row[col.key] || '').toLowerCase().includes(q)));
  renderDdTable(filtered);
}

function sortDrilldownTable(columnIndex) {
  const col = _ddCols[columnIndex];
  if (_ddSortCol === columnIndex) _ddSortDir = _ddSortDir === 'asc' ? 'desc' : 'asc';
  else { _ddSortCol = columnIndex; _ddSortDir = 'asc'; }
  const sorted = [..._ddView].sort((a, b) => {
    let av = a[col.key], bv = b[col.key];
    let cmp;
    if (col.type === 'currency' || col.type === 'number' || col.type === 'percent') cmp = parseFloat(av || 0) - parseFloat(bv || 0);
    else if (col.type === 'date') cmp = new Date(av || 0).getTime() - new Date(bv || 0).getTime();
    else cmp = String(av ?? '').localeCompare(String(bv ?? ''));
    return _ddSortDir === 'asc' ? cmp : -cmp;
  });
  renderDdTable(sorted);
}

function exportDrilldownData() {
  const title = document.getElementById('ddTitle').textContent || 'drilldown';
  const headers = _ddCols.map(c => c.label).join(',');
  const rows = _ddView.map(row => _ddCols.map(col => {
    let v = row[col.key] ?? '';
    if (String(v).includes(',') || String(v).includes('"')) v = '"' + String(v).replace(/"/g, '""') + '"';
    return v;
  }).join(',')).join('\n');
  const blob = new Blob([headers + '\n' + rows], { type: 'text/csv' });
  const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
  const a = document.createElement('a');
  a.href = url;
  a.download = `${title.replace(/\s+/g, '_')}_${moment().format('YYYY-MM-DD')}.csv`;
  a.style.display = 'none';
  document.body.appendChild(a);
  a.click();
  setTimeout(() => { document.body.removeChild(a); URL.revokeObjectURL(url); }, 0);
}

      poitem.description as part_description,
      poitem.qtytofulfill as qty,
      poitem.unitcost as unit_cost,
      (poitem.qtytofulfill * poitem.unitcost) as line_total
    FROM po
    JOIN poitem ON poitem.poid = po.id
    WHERE po.num = '${escSQL(poNum)}'
    ORDER BY poitem.id ASC`;
  debugLog(`Expanding line items for ${poNum}`, 'click');

      cell(it.part_description || '', '', false) +

      </tr></thead>
      <tbody>${bodyRows}</tbody>
    </table>
  </td>`;
  targetRow.insertAdjacentElement('afterend', exp);
}

const SD_DIMS = {
  vendor:   { label: 'Vendor',   allLabel: 'All Vendors',    opts: () => _filterOpts.vendors.map(v => ({ value:v.id, name:v.name })) },
  category: { label: 'Category', allLabel: 'All Categories', opts: () => _filterOpts.categories.map(n => ({ value:n, name:n })) },
  abc:      { label: 'ABC Code', allLabel: 'All ABC Codes',  opts: () => ([
                { value:'A', name:'A - High Value' },
                { value:'B', name:'B - Medium Value' },
                { value:'C', name:'C - Low Value' },
                { value:'N', name:'N - None' }
              ]) },
  location: { label: 'Location', allLabel: 'All Locations',  opts: () => _filterOpts.locations.map(l => ({ value:l.id, name:l.name })) }
};

function _sdEl(tag, cls, text) {
  const el = document.createElement(tag);
  if (cls) el.className = cls;
  if (text !== undefined) el.textContent = text;
  return el;
}

const SD_CARET = '<svg class="fdrop-caret" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" d="M6 9l6 6 6-6"/></svg>';
const SD_CAL   = '<svg fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" d="M8 7V3m8 4V3m-9 8h10M5 21h14a2 2 0 002-2V7a2 2 0 00-2-2H5a2 2 0 00-2 2v12a2 2 0 002 2z"/></svg>';

function _sdChip(labelHTML, active, open, onClick) {
  const btn = _sdEl('button', 'fchip fdrop-btn' + (active ? ' on' : '') + (open ? ' open' : ''));
  btn.type = 'button';
  btn.innerHTML = labelHTML + SD_CARET;
  btn.addEventListener('click', e => { e.stopPropagation(); onClick(); });
  return btn;
}

function _sdItem(name, selected, onPick) {
  const it = _sdEl('div', 'fdrop-item' + (selected ? ' sel' : ''));
  it.appendChild(_sdEl('span', 'fdrop-dot hollow'));
  it.appendChild(_sdEl('span', 'fdrop-name', name));
  it.addEventListener('click', e => { e.stopPropagation(); onPick(); });
  return it;
}

// Multi-select item — checkbox row; panel stays open on toggle.
function _sdMultiItem(name, checked, onToggle) {
  const it = _sdEl('div', 'fdrop-item' + (checked ? ' sel' : ''));
  const cb = document.createElement('input'); cb.type = 'checkbox'; cb.checked = checked;
  it.appendChild(cb);
  it.appendChild(_sdEl('span', 'fdrop-name', name));
  it.addEventListener('click', e => { e.stopPropagation(); onToggle(); });
  return it;
}

function _sdDateDrop() {
  const wrap = _sdEl('div', 'fdrop');
  const active = F.datePreset !== '90';
  wrap.appendChild(_sdChip(SD_CAL + '<span>' + '</span>', active, _openDrop === 'date', () => sdToggleDropdown('date')));
  wrap.querySelector('.fchip span').textContent = sdRangeLabel();
  const panel = _sdEl('div', 'fdrop-panel');
  if (_openDrop === 'date') panel.style.display = 'block';
  const head = _sdEl('div', 'fdrop-head');
  head.appendChild(_sdEl('span', null, 'Date range'));
  panel.appendChild(head);
  const list = _sdEl('div', 'fdrop-list');
  SD_RANGES.forEach(r => list.appendChild(_sdItem(r[1], F.datePreset === r[0], () => sdSetDateRange(r[0]))));
  panel.appendChild(list);
  if (F.datePreset === 'custom') {
    const row = _sdEl('div');
    row.style.cssText = 'display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;padding:6px 8px;';
    const mk = (which, val) => {
      const inp = document.createElement('input');
      inp.type = 'date';
      inp.value = val || '';
      inp.style.cssText = 'height:28px;border:1px solid var(--border-strong);border-radius:var(--r-btn);padding:0 6px;font-size:12px;font-family:inherit;color:var(--c-primary);';
      inp.addEventListener('click', e => e.stopPropagation());
      inp.addEventListener('change', () => sdSetCustom(which, inp.value));
      return inp;
    };
    row.appendChild(mk('start', F.customStart));
    row.appendChild(_sdEl('span', null, '–'));
    row.appendChild(mk('end', F.customEnd));
    panel.appendChild(row);
  }
  wrap.appendChild(panel);
  return wrap;
}

function _sdDimDrop(which) {
  const d = SD_DIMS[which];
  const wrap = _sdEl('div', 'fdrop');
  const sel = F[which] || [];
  const active = sel.length > 0;
  const opts = d.opts();
  let chipLabel;
  if (!active) {
    chipLabel = d.label;
  } else if (sel.length === 1) {
    const only = (opts.find(o => String(o.value) === String(sel[0])) || {}).name || sel[0];
    chipLabel = d.label.split(' ')[0] + ': ' + only;
  } else {
    chipLabel = d.label.split(' ')[0] + ': ' + sel.length;
  }
  const chip = _sdChip('<span></span>', active, _openDrop === which, () => sdToggleDropdown(which));
  chip.querySelector('span').textContent = chipLabel;
  wrap.appendChild(chip);
  const panel = _sdEl('div', 'fdrop-panel');
  if (_openDrop === which) panel.style.display = 'block';
  const head = _sdEl('div', 'fdrop-head');
  head.appendChild(_sdEl('span', null, d.label));
  if (active) {
    const clr = _sdEl('a', null, 'Clear');
    clr.addEventListener('click', e => { e.stopPropagation(); sdClearDim(which); });
    head.appendChild(clr);
  }
  panel.appendChild(head);
  const list = _sdEl('div', 'fdrop-list');
  opts.forEach(o => list.appendChild(_sdMultiItem(o.name, sel.includes(String(o.value)), () => sdToggleDim(which, o.value))));
  panel.appendChild(list);
  wrap.appendChild(panel);
  return wrap;
}

function renderFilterbar() {
  const bar = document.getElementById('filterBar');
  if (!bar) return;
  bar.innerHTML = '';
  bar.appendChild(_sdDateDrop());
  bar.appendChild(_sdEl('span', 'filter-sep'));
  Object.keys(SD_DIMS).forEach(k => bar.appendChild(_sdDimDrop(k)));
  bar.appendChild(_sdEl('span', 'filter-sep'));
  const anyDim = Object.keys(SD_DIMS).some(k => (F[k] || []).length > 0);
  const clear = _sdEl('button', 'fchip');
  clear.type = 'button';
  clear.style.color = anyDim ? 'var(--fb-negative)' : 'var(--c-tertiary)';
  clear.innerHTML = '<svg fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path stroke-linecap="round" d="M6 6l12 12M18 6L6 18"/></svg>Clear';
  clear.addEventListener('click', clearAllFilters);
  bar.appendChild(clear);
  bar.appendChild(_sdEl('span', 'spring'));
}

// Close any open dropdown on outside click / ESC
document.addEventListener('click', e => {
  if (_openDrop && !e.target.closest('.fdrop')) { _openDrop = null; renderFilterbar(); }
});
document.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
  if (e.key === 'Escape' && _openDrop) { _openDrop = null; renderFilterbar(); }
});

// Applies a saved/published filter state to F. Render-only — callers
// decide when to re-query (init runs one render pass at the end).
function applyFilterState(state) {
  if (!state) return;
  if (state.datePreset) F.datePreset = state.datePreset;
  F.customStart = state.customStart || '';
  F.customEnd   = state.customEnd || '';
  F.vendor      = toArr(state.vendor);
  F.category    = toArr(state.category);
  F.abc         = toArr(state.abc);
  F.location    = toArr(state.location);
  renderFilterbar();
  updateDateDisplay();
}

function onFilterChange() {
  debugLog('Filter changed — clearing cache and re-rendering', 'info');
  qclear();
  rerenderAll();
  updateKPIBadges();
  updateDateDisplay();
}

function clearAllFilters() {
  F.vendor   = [];
  F.category = [];
  F.abc      = [];
  F.location = [];
  renderFilterbar();
  onFilterChange();
}

function refreshDashboard() { qclear(); rerenderAll(); updateKPIBadges(); }

function toggleUserEditing() {
  if (!FBLib.Settings.isAdmin()) { showToast('Only a Fishbowl Admin can change this', 'error'); return; }
  const allowed = dashUserEditingAllowed();
  FBLib.Settings.setLock(allowed);   // setLock(true) = lock (currently allowed → lock it)
  updateAdminUI();
  showToast(!allowed ? 'User editing enabled' : 'User editing disabled', 'success');
  debugLog('userEditing set to: ' + !allowed, 'click');
}

function publishMasterLayout() {
  if (!FBLib.Settings.isAdmin()) { showToast('Only a Fishbowl Admin can publish', 'error'); return; }
  // Merge-then-publish: publishMaster REPLACES the whole master payload,
  // so carry any other published keys through.
  const master = Object.assign({}, FBLib.Settings.getMaster());
  master.masterLayout      = gatherLayout();
  master.masterFilterState = gatherFilterState();
  master.masterBadgeConfig = [..._badgeConfig];
  const ok = FBLib.Settings.publishMaster(master);
  if (!ok) { showToast('Publish failed — admin only', 'error'); return; }
  debugLog(`Master layout published (${master.masterLayout.length} widgets)`, 'success');
  showToast('Master layout published', 'success');
}

  if (btn) {
    const allowed = dashUserEditingAllowed();
    btn.classList.toggle('ok', allowed);
    btn.classList.toggle('ro', !allowed);
    btn.innerHTML = allowed
      ? function initGrid() {
  grid = GridStack.init({
    column:    12,
    cellHeight: 40,   // 40px rows: KPI tiles h:2 (~80px, Prod-Sched parity), charts h:10 (~400px)
    margin:    6,
    resizable: { handles: 'all' },
    // .wdrag = the widget header on normal widgets, the whole tile on
    // headerless KPI tiles (buttons inside are exempt via dd's default cancel).
    draggable: { handle: '.wdrag' },
    animate:   true
  }, '#myGrid');

  grid.on('resizestop', (ev, el) => { updateWidthClasses(); setTimeout(() => doRender(el), 60); });
  grid.on('change', updateWidthClasses);
  grid.on('added',  updateWidthClasses);
}
